articles.title: Luigi Mangione expected to plead guilty in federal case in UnitedHealthcare killing, AP source says
articles.description:
Mangione is accused of traveling to New York City to ambush Thompson, 50, then shooting him outside a Manhattan hotel on Dec. 4, 2024, as the executive walked to UnitedHealth Group’s annual investor conference.

The post Luigi Mangione expected to plead guilty in federal case in UnitedHealthcare killing, AP source says appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Luigi Mangione is expected to plead guilty in the UnitedHealthcare killing case.
Mangione allegedly shot executive Thompson, 50, on December 4, 2024, in NYC.
The case raises concerns about safety for Boston executives attending national conferences.

articles.title: Tiffani Faison to close Sweet Cheeks Q and Fool’s Errand in the Fenway
articles.description:
The chef and restaurateur will close both restaurants later this year.

The post Tiffani Faison to close Sweet Cheeks Q and Fool’s Errand in the Fenway appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Tiffani Faison will close Sweet Cheeks Q and Fool’s Errand by the end of 2023.
Both restaurants are located in the Fenway area, impacting local dining options.
Closure may affect jobs for staff and reduce culinary diversity in the neighborhood.

articles.title: Take a look inside New Hampshire’s oldest continuously operated inn after a makeover
articles.description:
The inn first opened in 1789.

The post Take a look inside New Hampshire’s oldest continuously operated inn after a makeover appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: New Hampshire's oldest inn, operating since 1789, recently underwent a significant renovation.
The makeover enhances the inn's appeal for Boston residents seeking nearby getaway options.
Improved facilities may boost tourism and local economy for both New Hampshire and Boston.
